ticket.title: rabbet admin stats ignores --db-path and RABBET_DB_PATH
ticket.description: Found while verifying GB-216: with the corpus at /tmp/gb216.db holding 33 accepted traces, `RABBET_DB_PATH=/tmp/gb216.db rabbet admin stats` reported "Database: rabbet.db" and 0 traces, and `--db-path` is not accepted at all (error: unexpected argument). The ingest, mine-patterns and export-parquet subcommands all take --db-path, so the one command a maintainer reaches for first to confirm an import is the one that looks at a different database. Either give admin stats the same --db-path/RABBET_DB_PATH handling as the others, or print the resolved path prominently so the mismatch is obvious.
